arguments:
{"script":"set -e
ws=group_count_workspace
mkdir -p "$ws"
cp /etc/group "$ws/group_raw.txt"
orig="$ws/group_raw.txt"
clean="$ws/group_clean.txt"
orig_count=$(wc -l < "$orig" | tr -d ' ')
# remove blank lines and comment lines, then normalize whitespace
grep -v -E '^\s*($|#)' "$orig" | awk '{gsub(/[[:space:]]+/," "); sub(/^ /,""); sub(/ $/,""); print}' > "$clean"
cleaned_count=$(wc -l < "$clean" | tr -d ' ')
removed=$((orig_count - cleaned_count))
printf "%s\n" "$removed" > "$ws/cleanup_log.txt"
# extract unique group names
cut -d: -f1 "$clean" | sort -u > "$ws/group_unique.txt"
uniq_count=$(wc -l < "$ws/group_unique.txt" | tr -d ' ')
sha256sum "$ws/group_unique.txt" > "$ws/group_unique.fingerprint"
# compare metadata (file size) between original and copied source
src_size=$(stat -c%s /etc/group)
copy_size=$(stat -c%s "$ws/group_raw.txt")
consistency="inconsistent"
[ "$src_size" -eq "$copy_size" ] && consistency="consistent"
# readiness summary
printf "source_file line_count\n" > "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
printf "%s %s\n" "group_raw.txt" "$orig_count" >> "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
printf "%s %s\n" "group_clean.txt" "$cleaned_count" >> "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
printf "%s %s\n" "group_unique.txt" "$uniq_count" >> "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
printf "\nfingerprint:\n" >> "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
cat "$ws/group_unique.fingerprint" >> "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
printf "\nconsistency: %s\n" "$consistency" >> "$ws/ready_for_count.txt"
# output the number of unique groups
echo "$uniq_count""}
